title: Cover native opening refusal when the held claim fence differs from the named root fence
outcome: A native S0 regression proves current held-claim fence disagreement with the named root withholds publication through the existing authority read.
acceptance: Through existing native-opening seams, a held claim whose fence exceeds the selected root fence produces authority refusal and no published S0.
The test verifies observable refusal without real sleeps, string-pinning repository instructions, new product conditions or duplicated source policy.
